interpretation_guardrails: Bootstrap distributions quantify finite-sample sensitivity; they do not create an independent validation set.
Calibration-score resampling does not authorize selecting a new threshold from test performance.
Moving-block calibration bootstrap is a sensitivity analysis for possible local acquisition dependence.
Wilson intervals are binomial reference intervals and assume recording-level Bernoulli sampling.
A degenerate bootstrap AUC interval at 1.0 means complete separation in this observed sample, not population AUC exactly equal to 1.
No uncertainty result may be used to promote a detector without a separate confirmatory dataset.
